name: knoxcall/sdk
description: Official PHP SDK for the KnoxCall API

suggest.php-http/discovery: Auto-discovers your PSR-17 factories and PSR-18 client for wrap()->httpClient(); otherwise pass response_factory/stream_factory/direct_client explicitly.
suggest.psr/http-client-implementation: A PSR-18 client (e.g. guzzlehttp/guzzle ^7) — needed only for wrap httpClient route-around/direct calls.
suggest.psr/http-factory-implementation: A PSR-17 factory (e.g. nyholm/psr7) — needed to build responses from wrap()->httpClient() unless you pass factories explicitly.
suggest.psr/simple-cache-implementation: A PSR-16 cache (APCu, Redis, …) to share the intercept manifest across PHP processes via wrap()->httpClient(['cache' => $cache]); without one each process fetches it once per TTL.
